text:
Zara: Heads-up  — paid performance wobble after the creative refresh. Need a fast micro-budget plan: 2 creatives x 2 retarget windows + tightened kw set + pacing rules. Can we run a 24h microtest?

Evan: Yes. Proposal: keep test limited to high-intent queries only, run 12h canary at 10% spend then expand to 30% if signals positive. Keywords to include: `redwood inference`, `LLM inference platform`, `inference cost optimization`.

AdOps Bot: latest-hourly.csv uploaded -> https://storage.redwood.com/ads/reports/244210/hourly.csv (AM CTR -0.8%, CPC +9%).

Priya: Creative plan: "fast LLM features" (short) vs "cut inference cost per token" (benefit). Landing variants: concise hero vs customer stat. File names on drive: https://drive.redwood.com/mktg/q3_micro (files: micro_short_v1.jpg, micro_benefit_v1.jpg, lp_hero.html, lp_stat.html).

Marcus: Ops constraints: day budget $8k, retarget $2k. pacing_smoothing=0.35, frequency cap retarget=3/day. Disable auto-bid jumps >12% during test. Webhook SLA: 200 < 500ms or route to retry queue.

Evan: I'll set ad groups and negatives for "free", "download" and broad-match blockers. Canary rules: 12h at 10% spend; scale to 30% if CTR >= +6% and CPL <= -10% vs weekly baseline.

Priya: Uploading assets now and will pin creative versions in the shared drive. Drafting 3 micro headlines to rotate in canary: 1) "Ship LLM features in days" 2) "Lower inference cost per token" 3) "Reliable, low-latency LLM serving".

Zara: Analytics: label cohorts micro_A, micro_B, rt_30d, rt_7d. We'll compare SQL rate and lead response time. Alert if CPL spikes >25% for 2 windows.

Marcus: Inbound mapping test (CRM requires gclid + utm_content). Use this curl to validate:
```
curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.com/inbound \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"source":"google","gclid":"TEST244210","utm_campaign":"q3_micro","utm_content":"micro_short_v1"}'
```

Evan: I'll implement the canary now and pin rollout notes. Also will limit kw set during canary to branded + top 4 non-branded to keep noise down.

Priya: Assets live and linked in campaign. Also added a variant with a customer stat card. :white_check_mark:

AdOps Bot: canary_log_244210.txt -> https://storage.redwood.com/ads/canary/244210/log.txt

Zara: Quick ops reminders: - ensure fallback queue tags lead with `microtest` - keep lookback window 30d - no bid scaling >15% after canary expand.

Evan: Canary deployed. Will post hourly pacing updates here. :rocket:

Marcus: Did a webhook check, got 200 and payload present in CRM staging.

Zara: Monitoring first 6h. If CTR drops >5% or CPL rises >20% we pause and revert creative immediately. Keep updates short in this thread. :eyes:
